posts.subject: SwiftySpeed's Dream Knife Application
posts.bodyHtml:
Hey there!
I would just like to start off by saying that I do meet all requirements under my own beliefs to become a Test-Admin.
My name is Kyle, however I am better well known as SwiftySpeed and have been throughout my online existence. I am 16 years old and from the UK, speaking English along side a little German as I did study it at School for 3 years.


I would like to join the administrative team because I do believe that I can help improve the server in several ways. For example, I think that I can come up with ideas for the server and develop them to achieve the criteria of it to make things more enjoyable for the community. I also do believe that because I am from the UK, I can be on at times where there are no other Admins online which will obviously help keeping the server a clean and positive place. I can identify other languages to some extent meaning that if players speak in either of the two chats using neither German/English related language, I could quite possibly pick that out.


I have been playing on DREAM for at least 4-6 months now which has given me time to realise and play by all the rules as well as become a well known player to the community. I do believe that because I am known on the server, players will respect me and abide by the rules whilst I am there to guide their ways.


My favourite hobbies are playing any kind of sports, for example football which I do play regularly and gaming which I do almost everyday. I do play on Dream's Knife server at least once everyday that I am online and do enjoy it even though it isn't the main CS:GO objective, but more of a minigame aspect to it. I also do know that people will say how I am not active on the forums nor TS3 however I am aiming to be on both as much as possible from now on.


I do believe that I am a very mature young adult. I may have my downsides and may being stupid at times however I do act very maturely when it comes to serious things such as moderation or administration. I have never been an Admin on a CS:GO server however have always had that goal to for Dream. I may not know many commands however I do know a few which also relates to the fact that I am a fast learner and can easily adapt to the job.


As I just said, I have never had experience in administration of a CS:GO server.


My weekly timetable in which shows when I am available on CS:GO. Please note that this is not 100% accurate as times may change due to family issues/occasions, School and Work.
Also note that this is in GMT time zone.

Scenario: User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?
Firstly I would tell User 1 to stop and warn him that if he says anything further then he will be punished (Muted). If he was to then continue after the mute expires I would instantly mute him without a warning.


Strengths:
My strengths would be that I am a very fair and mature person, knowing most of the community, having a lot of free time and I am quite a patient person that doesn't get frustrated easily. Being fair and mature helps because I am not biased meaning that if I was dealing with an issue I wouldn't protect/have any sort of favouritism to either of the players. Knowing most of the community can help because I know who to watch and which players are repeat offenders as well as gaining respect from a fair amount of the community. Having a lot of free time will mean that I can be active a lot of the time and be there to help while players need it.



Weaknesses:
My weaknesses are things like inactivity on the forums and TS3. As I have said already, I do guarantee that I am to work harder to stay active on both the forums and TS3 which I haven't done before however will improve a lot more as time comes.


To finish this off, I would just like to mention that I currently don't have access to the account which I used to donate and play on for most of the time I played on DREAM, therefore my current account is being used. I'm not going to go into depth however, unfortunately my main account was hijacked and stolen and I am currently in the works with steam support on fixing the issue.


I would lastly like to say thank you to the staff team for allowing me to apply.
~Swifty 😄
Could be a tad bit more active in voice chat in-game, aside from that you gucci.
I appreciate the feedback dude :'D I try to speak as much as possible but not to the extent of where everyone wants to mute me 😛

Hello SwiftySpeed! Definitely extremely nice to see that not only you enjoy playing on our servers but actually, you want to help out our Admin Team too 😄 👍 .


As for any other application, I have made a Pro's and Con's list and will be making a final judgement at the end:


Pros:
[like*] You meet all the requirements
[like*] You seem to want to help the Dream community progress already (thinking about further stuff that can be improved etc).
[like*] You have indeed played on Dream for quite a long time but can I request to know your full activity? (stamm points)
[like*] You certainly are mature and you have gained my respect as a friend 😄
[like*] You have never been complained about, never been disrespectful and always followed the rules! 👍
[like*] You seem to have knowledge on both English and some German which does benefit greatly towards the role of you being admin.
[like*] You seem to have a very, very free timetable and got a lot of time on your hands however...


Cons:
[disli-ke*] You have a lot of time, but I'm fairly sure you don't much of that time on our Dream servers (otherwise your stamm points would be around the same amount as mine, if not, even more).
[disli-ke*] You are certainly mature, but I'm afraid I haven't seen you necessarily deal with any complaints or correcting any misbehavior on the server.
[disli-ke*] Your lack of administration is definitely a downfall but I'm sure you'll be able to pick it up quickly.
[disli-ke*] You don't talk much on the server and as though many people do respect you, I think you would need to engage with the players more in order to maintain some fun on the server too 👍 😄
[disli-ke*] You said that when you deal with complaints, you would simply mute them but have you considered what you will do after a mute? Maybe you would give him a ban or give more warnings? Length of ban? You need to be fair but strict at the same time when being an admin 😄


Overall, I think that for me, it is a YES, you are certainly mature but I'm not sure of what your admin capabilities are but as this if your first time, it looks like we'll see 👍


I wish you the best,


~Doo Doo

Thanks for the positive feedback as well as constructive criticism.
It does say that my Stamm level is low but this is my current account I have to use and my old account which was stolen recently had a tonn more play time on it. I'm not sure exactly how much but I'm sure I was Silver and getting close to Gold.


I have lost several things from not only my inventory but also cosmetics for the Dream server such as trails and masks etc... I have been trying to get my account back but Vavle support team do not seem to believe that I am the rightful owner of the account.


I'm not sure if it still relates to that account on the forums in terms of Stamm points but I did have a tonn on my main account which really annoys me.


Thanks again!
~Swifty 😄

For now, i have no informations about you, i havent met you on knife server so far, i guess. Correct me if I m wrong.


Since i have no informations about you, i cant say No, but i cant say Yes.


I wish you good luck, if you get a chance to proof yourself. And please dont disappoint us by abusing admin power.



Greetz ifZ4ne

I'm sure I've been on multiple times at the same time as you but maybe never really took notice into it.


I can 100% say that I prefer to impress rather than let people down. I would love to have the opportunity at being an Admin on Dream however I am yet to impress but I'm sure I shall. 😄

Hello Swifty,
It's nice to hear that you applied as a test-admin for knife server of Dream . I will move onto Pros and Cons
Starting off with the Pros:
- You know the rules fully
- You are really active on knife server
- I got to talk to you for a bit and you seem like a great person
- You try to communicate with other people alot
- You try to help others with their problem on dream
- You fullfill all the need for this role
Onto the cons:
- You're not very active on forum and the ts3


As you can see there is not alot of Cons from my side when comparing them to the Pros,
So from me you get a big YES.
Wish you good luck.


Kind Regards


Michal "OxygeN" J.

Thanks for the kind words Oxygen.
I have over the past few days been on the forums at least once every couple of hours and am willing to continue to do so, I got team speak a day or so ago and have just started using it. Due to my lack of experience with team speak, I am trying to learn how to use it fully very gradually.


Soon I shall know how and will be active on not only the server but both the forums and team speak as well. 😄

Well, it's been over a week since the last reply now, maybe an answer from a higher admin would be appreciated?
